jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Structural Biology of Protein Kinase Regulation by RNA Helicases (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network.

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

How cells communicate with their environment via cell-cell interactions and by growth factors is a key question in the molecular life sciences, including tumor biology. Wnt signaling plays an important role in embryonic development and cancer.

In the Division of Molecular Embryology (headed by Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs), we study mechanisms of Wnt pathway regulation. To this end, we identify developmental control genes, investigate their biological role and biochemical mode of action, and examine how the genes are regulated.

To strengthen our team, we are seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Postdoc in Structural Biology of Protein Kinase Regulation by RNA Helicases.

Your Tasks

The Niehrs laboratory has identified DEAD-box RNA helicases as novel activators of protein kinases. In the context of Wnt-β-catenin signaling, DDX3 and CK1 cooperate and are both oncogenes. Understanding their regulatory interaction is therefore of considerable interest for the development of novel cancer therapeutics.

To unravel the mode of action whereby DDX3X activates CK1, you will solve and characterize the 3D structure of a DDX3-CK. To that end, you will produce recombinant DDX3X and CK1 proteins, purify and characterize their complexes using biochemical and biophysical methods. You will subject the kinase complexes to structural analysis using cryo-EM SPA or X-ray crystallography.

This project will be carried out in close collaboration between the laboratories of Prof. Dr. Irmgard Sinning at the University of Heidelberg and Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs at the DKFZ. The postdoc will primarily work in the lab of Prof. Sinning and will receive training in a broad range of state-of-the-art techniques in structural biochemistry and biophysics.  

Techniques employed include recombinant protein production, FPLC, Western blotting, automated protein crystallization, single-particle cryo-EM (SPA), advanced X-ray structure determination using synchrotron radiation, AI-assisted protein modeling, hydrogen–deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS), microscale thermophoresis (MST), and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC).

Your Profile

Applicants should hold a master's degree in molecular life sciences (e.g., biochemistry, biotechnology, molecular biology) with a background in recombinant protein work and/or structural biology. The applicant should be able to pursue research projects independently as well as in collaborations. Good written and oral command of English is essential.

Please submit a single PDF file including a CV (Germans: copies of Abitur & Masters degree), a cover letter stating your research and career interests, certificates, your expected availability date, and a list of publications, and attach two letters of reference.

Incomplete applications will not be considered or acknowledged.  

References:
Cruciat et al. (2013). RNA helicase DDX3 is a regulatory subunit of casein kinase 1 in Wnt-β-catenin signaling. Science 339, 1436-1441.

Fatti et al. (2023) DEAD-box RNA helicases act as nucleotide exchange factors for Casein Kinase 2. Science Signalling 16, eabp8923

Hirth et al. (2024) DEAD-box RNA helicases are pervasive protein kinase interactors and activators. Genome Res. 34, 952-966.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Your New Team

Do you want to play a key role in developing next-generation medical diagnostic devices that improve the lives of millions of patients? We combine innovative circuit design with the highest quality standards. Together, we shape the future of healthcare—precisely, reliably, and with a forward-looking approach. In our Hardware Development department, you will join a highly motivated, interdisciplinary team of engineers, software specialists, and system architects. We foster an open feedback culture, interact as equals, and support one another through complex technical challenges. From the initial concept to series production, we work hand in hand.

The Opportunity

In the role of Senior Electronics Engineer (m/f/d), you will take charge of the conceptualization and circuit design of analogue and digital assemblies for diagnostic devices in medical applications. Building prototypes and demonstrators, conducting systematic troubleshooting at the assembly and component levels, and performing EMC pre-compliance testing will be part of your daily routine. You will also actively contribute to risk analyses and Design FMEAs, implementing technical safety measures directly into the electronics design.

Additionally, you can look forward to the following exciting tasks:

* Specifications & System Requirements: Define electronics specifications and interface documentation, actively contributing to global system requirements.
* Standards-Compliant Design (IEC 60601): Design circuits in compliance with DIN EN 60601-1 (electrical safety, isolation concepts, MOPP/MOOP, clearance and creepage distances) and DIN EN 60601-1-2 (EMC).
* Approval & CE Compliance: Prepare, execute, and document standards-relevant tests to support external CE certifications in accredited testing laboratories.
* Process & Interface Collaboration: Create technical documentation, oversee the transition of designs into volume production (DFM/DFT), and coordinate closely with adjacent technical disciplines.
* Mentoring: Conduct design reviews and support junior team members with your technical expertise.

Who You Are

For this challenging role, you hold a successfully completed degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Medical Engineering, Mechatronics, Communications Engineering, or a comparable qualification. You bring at least 5–10 years of solid experience in independent hardware development, ideally gained within the regulated medical technology sector. Routine experience with common design tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCAD, EAGLE, or OrCAD) and circuit simulation (e.g., SPICE) is second nature to you.

The following attributes complete your profile:

* Circuit Design: Sound knowledge of analogue and digital circuit design—especially low-power design for battery-operated devices. Specific expertise in analogue technology, RF design, or electrical/functional safety is an advantage.
* Measurement & Lab Equipment: Strong practical experience using oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, logic analysers, and electrical safety testing equipment.
* Standards & Regulatory Knowledge: Proficiency with the IEC 60601-1 / 60601-1-2 family of standards, understanding of ISO 14971 (risk management), and familiarity with CE approval processes for medical devices.
* Manufacturing Expertise: Deep insight into EMC-compliant design, Design for Manufacturability/Testability (DFM/DFT), and obsolescence management.
* Language Skills: Business-fluent German and excellent written and spoken English skills.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the EuroDrone Plateau, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) Digitalization Officer for Programme Management

You are a full-time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Project Manager (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us at the EuroDrone Plateau as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Ingolstadt
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration: 1 year with possible prolongation

You have a unique chance to participate, learn and grow in the full development cycle of European Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS), aka Eurodrone.

The Eurodrone Program, which is led by Airbus as Prime Contractor in front of the customer (OCCAR: Organisation Conjointe de Coopération en matière d’Armement) and accounts several sub-contractors and suppliers across Europe, is organized in multi-disciplinary Delivery Teams (DTs) ensuring a cross-national, cross-company multi-functional integration and delivery of sub-products. In the specific case of this position, the focus will be primarily on the core business of the MAGiCS Team e.g. the operational components of Eurodrone: Mission, Armament, Ground Control Station, Human Machine Interface and Human Factors Engineering. Efficiency of the development cycle is supported by a plateau located in Ingolstadt (Manching site) where all key actors are cooperating under one roof.

We are seeking a highly motivated working student to join our team of DT MAGiCS as a Digitalization Officer for Programme Management. As the Digitalization Officer for Programme Management, you will be responsible for digitalizing the project management environment using Jira, Confluence and Sharepoint. This includes setting up workflows,creating and assigning tasks, tracking progress, and mastering the challenge of artificial intelligence within Jira. You will work closely with the project manager and the rest of the project team to ensure that the project is delivered on time, on cost, and on quality.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our daily business.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Digitalize the project management environment using Jira, Confluence and Sharepoint.
- Collaborate with stakeholders and identify potential improvement areas.
- Set up workflows, create and assign tasks, and track progress using Jira.
- Master the challenge of artificial intelligence within Jira.
- Support the Delivery Team Lead and the project managers as needed in project tracking.
- Contribute in reporting activities to make them leaner and more valuable.
- Participate and contribute to Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) routines as Program Increments (PI) planning, Product Owners sync, Systems Demos, Weekly/Daily stand-ups, Retrospectives, etc.
- Discover Performance Management routines and promote best practices.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Currently full time enrolled in a Bachelors or Masters degree program in a relevant field (e.g. business administration, engineering, or computer science) with a strong interest in project management and digitalization.
- Reliable, adaptable, independent with a hands-on mindset, personal initiative and practical problem solving.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills.
- Good organization skills, with Knowledge of Jira, Confluence and Sharepoint is a plus.Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) would be a plus.
- Very good English skills (written and verbal), another Eurodrone language would be a plus (e.g. German / Spanish / Italian / French).
